nc0cab4bfad.headline: The Junta assures that the IRPF reduction will benefit more than 333,000 people from Córdoba
nc0cab4bfad.summary: The regional government of Córdoba announced that a tax reduction on home purchases will benefit more than 333,000 people and help over 4,200 families.
nc0cab4bfad.why: Tax incentives on housing can stimulate real estate markets and consumer spending, impacting regional economic activity.
